commentary.text: 90+7' Jeremie Pignard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+3' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Florian Sotoca (Lens) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
88' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.
87' Here is a change. David Pereira da Costa is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Salis Abdul Samed (Lens).

71' Panos Katseris (Lorient) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' Panos Katseris (Lorient) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Lens.

69' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

60' Lorient have a goal ruled out for offside!

58' Elye Wahi (Lens) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
57' Unsporting behaviour by Elye Wahi (Lens).

48' Imran Louza (Lorient) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' Half-time substitution. Franck Haise decided to make a change. Kevin Danso is replaced by Massadio Haidara (Lens).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Elye Wahi (Lens) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Lens get a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Good movement by Panos Katseris (Lorient), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
45' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
42' Panos Katseris (Lorient) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

37' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
35' A lofted cross from Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
34' The referee blows for a cooling break.
32' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Facundo Medina (Lens), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
32' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
32' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
31' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
30' The ball is cleared after Elye Wahi (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

29' Panos Katseris (Lorient) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
28' Deiver Machado (Lens) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.

26' Imran Louza (Lorient) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
23' Florian Sotoca (Lens) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
20' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
19' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
19' Lorient quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
18' Chance! Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Julien Ponceau, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
17' Imran Louza (Lorient) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
16' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Elye Wahi (Lens) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Lens earn a corner.
14' Elye Wahi (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) commits a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
7' Elye Wahi (Lens) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
7' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Panos Katseris (Lorient), but the defence gets it clear.
5' Deiver Machado (Lens) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
4' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
